kjv: hide them in the clay in the brickkiln
mine: hide them in the mortar in the brick pavement
note: Hebrew malben here is a brick terrace or pavement at the palace entrance (excavations at Tahpanhes found such a platform), not a kiln.

kjv: he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment
mine: he shall clean the land of Egypt as a shepherd cleans his cloak of vermin
note: Hebrew 'atah can mean "wrap oneself" or "delouse, pick clean" (cf. Isa 22:17); the second gives a sharper image of Nebuchadnezzar picking Egypt clean.
